Aisha Khan: Postmortem follow-up: billing overcount from delayed ingests + retry duplicates. Need concrete owners for the remediation checklist (backfill, dedupe, credits). Please ACK and claim items by EOD.

Tom Brewster: ACK. I'll own dedupe patch + tests. Plan: add request_fingerprint TTL and tighten retry dedupe logic. ETA PR by 2026-02-02.

Maya Lin: I'll run invoice dry-run and prepare credit memos once we have the CSV. Need the impacted invoice export.

Aisha Khan: Preliminary owners/dates:
- Tom Brewster — dedupe fix + tests — due 2026-02-02
- Maya Lin — invoice dry-run + credit table — due 2026-02-04
- OpsSam — deploy guard (post-deploy throttle) + metrics — due 2026-02-01
- Rachel Ortiz — customer comms + legal review — due 2026-02-05
Confirm or propose changes.

BillingBot: ALERT: 29 invoices flagged in BILL-2412. Suggested next step: upload dry-run CSV and generate draft memos.

OpsSam: I'll add a 3-minute post-deploy throttle and a retry storm metric. Will post canary logs to BILL-2412.

Tom Brewster: I'll prototype TTL=30s for fingerprints and add unit/integration tests covering concurrent retry windows. Will include leader-election notes for backfill coordination.

Maya Lin: Once CSV is available, I'll run dry-run SQL and post results. Sample SQL I'll use:
```sql
SELECT invoice_id, customer_id, SUM(token_delta) as delta_tokens
FROM metered_usage
WHERE event_ts >= '2026-02-01' AND event_ts < '2026-02-02'
GROUP BY invoice_id, customer_id
HAVING ABS(SUM(token_delta)) > 500;
```

Rachel Ortiz: I'll draft the customer email template and attach sample credit memos for legal. Want to offer expedited credits for top-affected customers.

Aisha Khan: Two operational rules: (1) backfill must write append-only adjustment records (no mutation), (2) backfill runs must be leader-elected and idempotent. Add audit fields: job_run_id, operator, signed checksum.

Tom Brewster: Noted. I'll coordinate with Maya on backfill outputs so credits align.

Maya Lin: Will post dry-run CSV to BILL-2412 when ready and run a canary on top-5 invoices first.

OpsSam: Canary throttle started on staging at 11:10 PT — no retry storm observed in 30m window. Logs uploaded.

BillingBot: BILL-2412 checklist updated: 29 invoices pending review.

Aisha Khan: Sync scheduled tomorrow 09:30 PT to review canary, PR, and dry-run. If blockers, ping me directly. Closing thread until sync. :white_check_mark:
